result.title: AOV-GS: Active Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping with 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Published at AIST 2026
result.summary: Robots deployed in human-centered environments need maps that support both geometric navigation and open-vocabulary semantic queries beyond a fixed label set. A key challenge is enriching such maps with semantic information without relying on manually annotated segmentation masks or closed-set semantic categories. Existing geometry-driven active mapping maximizes coverage but treats semantics as a passive by-product of the collected trajectory, whereas active semantic mapping typically depends on supervised semantic segmentation. We present AOV-GS, an active 3D Gaussian mapping system that guides exploration using frozen foundation models. During coarse exploration, AOV-GS re-ranks geometrically promising candidate views according to CLIP mask-embedding novelty computed from SAM instance segmentation, biasing exploration toward semantically informative regions. Frozen SAM and CLIP provide instance masks and language-aligned embeddings throughout mapping, while a lightweight scene-specific language field is fitted offline directly to the collected CLIP embeddings rather than manually annotated masks, enabling open-vocabulary text-query segmentation on novel views. In a controlled comparison using the same SAM-CLIP perception stack, AOV-GS improves average language-field mIoU over geometry-only active planning by 1.3 percentage points on Replica (34.6% on eight scenes) and by 1.8 points on Matterport3D (23.1% on five scenes). With CorrCLIP, AOV-GS reaches 35.6% on Replica, 2.0 points above the matched Geometry-based + CorrCLIP baseline. Novel-view PSNR remains comparable to the geometry-only baseline on both datasets while depth L1 improves on Replica. Code is available at https://github.com/OptimusFaber/AOV-GS.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AOV-GS，一个主动开放词表语义建图系统：粗探索阶段用冻结 SAM 实例掩码与 CLIP 嵌入的新颖度重排候选视角，并在采集数据上离线拟合轻量语言场，支持新视角的文本查询分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 以基础模型语义新颖度驱动「下一视角」选择的主动感知思路，可能为 VLM 推理中何处补充视觉证据、LOOK 决策提供参考，但它面向机器人建图而非 latent 推理状态，迁移性需核查。
